changes.title: Cauldron live
items: Mushrooms grow by the dancefloor at home. Walk over them to pick them up; in the kitchen they hop into the baskets, E at a basket throws one into the cauldron, and three make a brew.

changes.title: Readable logs
items: Pause now offers a readable text log alongside the builders' JSON log. Repeated messages show counts, and older routine records make room for warnings and errors.

changes.title: Log recovery
items: Playtest logs are saved during play. After an unexpected reload, a notice offers the kept log; errors and comments include the last 50 notable events.
